proof: TOWN OF LUNENBURG TRUST FUNDS, `FISCAL YEAR 2018 SUMMARY`, `Page 1 of 3` -- page 44 of the FY2018 annual town report. THE PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH (one image, 936x1294, 110 dpi) and is printed SIDEWAYS; it was rendered with render_pdf_page.swift at scale 5 and READ. No recognition was used, and the OCR cache for this page is not a starting point. The page prints THREE groups and 22 funds -- CEMETERY (3), CONSERVATION (5), LIBRARY (14) -- each with its own printed SUBTOTALS line, in EIGHT money columns: BEGINNING PRINCIPAL, BEGINNING EARNINGS, NET EARNINGS, TRANSFERS/DISTRIBUTE OF PRINCIPAL, TRANSFERS/DISBURSE OF EARNINGS, ENDING CASH VALUE, UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS and ENDING MARKET VALUE. It carries neither a BEGINNING MARKET VALUE column nor a CHANGE IN UNREALIZED column, which the same table does carry in other years -- so the third row identity those years support cannot be stated here and is not. The ACCOUNT NUMBER column is printed and EMPTY throughout. WHAT PROVES IT: 68 assertions, all exact to the cent. 22 rows x 2 row identities (beginning principal + beginning earnings + net earnings + transfers of principal + transfers of earnings = ending cash value; ending cash value + unrealized gain/loss = ending market value) and 3 printed SUBTOTALS lines x 8 columns. One wrong digit anywhere breaks at least one of them. This page ends at the LIBRARY SUBTOTALS; pages 45 and 46 carry the rest of the statement and were already proven.
